name: Yantho'Ic'Thal
source:
Yantho'Ic'Thal is a servant of the Order of the Universal Panacea working at the Sanctuary of Apsu at the time of the conclave. He has an unexplained neurological condition rendering him incapable of speech, instead making him reliant on an artifice allowing him to display words on a glass tablet. 

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Yantho%27Ic%27Thal]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
